responsibility: This generator derives genrtl.h from rtl.def by emitting the low-level inline constructors and convenience macros for allocating and initializing RTL objects. It groups RTL codes by format strings, generates init_rtx_fmt_* and gen_rtx_fmt_* helpers, maps format letters to field types and accessors, and then defines per-RTX gen_rtx_* or gen_rtx_raw_* macros while excluding special forms that need custom handling elsewhere in emit-rtl.cc.
